/seo/description.source_en: Large-coach Busan coastal day tour for cruise passengers: 9 signature stops with cruise-terminal pickup and a return-before-sail-away guarantee.

/seo/metaDescription.source_en: 8-hour Busan coastal bus tour for cruise passengers from Busan Port Cruise Terminal: Yonggungsa, UN Memorial, Jagalchi/BIFF/Gukje, Gamcheon, Songdo, Yongdusan — return guaranteed before sail-away.

/hero/meta/duration.source_en: ≈ 8 hours, timed to your cruise's port-call window

/hero/tagline.source_en: Eight Busan signatures on a large coach — picked up at your cruise terminal and returned with comfortable buffer before sail-away

/catalog_card/shortCardDescription.source_en: A large-coach Busan coastal day tour built for cruise passengers: cruise terminal pickup, 9 signature stops (⟦G2⟧, ⟦G1⟧, ⟦G3⟧, ⟦G7⟧, ⟦G5⟧, ⟦G0⟧, ⟦G6⟧, ⟦G4⟧), and a return-before-sail-away guarantee. Budget tier — same circuit as the small-group product, larger coach.

/pickup_dropoff/primary/name.source_en: Busan International Cruise Terminal (영도 크루즈항 — Dongsam, Yeongdo)
/pickup_dropoff/primary/name.tm: Busan International Cruise Terminal (영도 크루즈항 — Dongsam, Yeongdo)

/pickup_dropoff/primary/time.source_en: Confirmed at booking (≈30 min after ship docking) / Return ≈90 min before sail-away

/pickup_dropoff/primary/instructions.source_en: Busan cruise ships berth at either terminal — which one applies to you depends on where your ship docks, and is confirmed at booking. Meet your guide in the arrival hall.
/pickup_dropoff/primary/instructions.tm: Kreuzfahrtschiffe in Busan legen an einem der beiden Terminals an — welches für Sie gilt, hängt davon ab, wo Ihr Schiff festmacht, und wird bei der Buchung bestätigt. Ihre Reiseleitung treffen Sie in der Ankunftshalle.
